[2026-10-27 03:49 CET] PR #182 is now merged at main 64cfe9fc6fb9df5a3957ba8821fae3e88f1790ea and integrated into formalize at 865facc70ba6a10b6a875c60d1bb3ceb8c2d2cb3. The implementation and regression sources equal upstream. The original constrained reproducer was rerun locally in Nix after rebuilding the changed code: Just (5,p(h(b),b)), first termsByCost term cost 5, classAutomaton Right True. Exact 118-byte output SHA256 4414d3a1236d3e56c4ac279637fb7d8c71fe0d40b3a5fe3cd5188b3d1ad1e943. Core suite 341 examples/0 failures with seed 20261027; both changed Haskell Fourmolu checks and cfta Cabal-gild pass. FINDINGS now marks the witness repaired and retains the original baseline failure, monotonicity contract and infinite rejected-language termination caveat. No additional patch is required for this witness.

New proof progress: seven modules in local commits b474c9f6a, 3b491a34e and ae964e335 carry exact flat root/size correspondence through the six-field enumeration core. They preserve complete ordered successes, rejections and explicit errors for representative, union, raw/get/setValue, allocation, ancestry, assimilation and incoming-node merge. Genuine old bounds are synchronized and stable. Related cores permit exactly the same complete assignments, including stored restrictions and residual guards. Audit passes 3989 jobs/78183 theorem dependencies; installed readback covers 34 new theorems, unchanged H6 and captured renderer, and 19 full definitions.

Important remaining boundary: this core relation does not imply explicit-map support bounds or Safe, nor native expandable/waiting indexes or Caller/memo/query correspondence. A flat forest with an explicit singleton at every Nat can relate semantically to an empty old map, so stored-address bounds need their own history proof. Full recursive output soundness/completeness, discharge/rendering existence and current native worker transport remain open. Checkpoint evidence and restart notes are being prepared for the authorized formalize push.
